description: List OAuth providers enabled on the development instance, the credential fields each needs in production, and whether production already has them (the OAuth step of `clerk deploy`).

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.

name: get_deploy_oauth_providers

configured.description: Whether production already has the required credentials.

unsupported.description: Enabled providers whose credential fields could not be described.

title: Get OAuth providers needing production credentials
